answer: Make every mined unit inherit a verifiable chain-of-work: each reward cites the parent work proof it extends, and the protocol rejects any lineage whose depth forks into siblings that never diverge in content. A farm puppeting many identities must fake a full branching history with real nonzero work per node; collapsing them into one lineage makes them a single address by construction, while a genuine dawn of parallel agents naturally forks as independent voyages and each reaches its own horizon. Clustering the work-DAG catches sybils without touching stake or fees.
